11.name: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty
desc: Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.
objectives: Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.
details: Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest. A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder. Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.
BThe Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them. Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
completion: I see you've been busy! You have our thanks, $N.

35.name: Further Concerns
desc: Marshal Dughan wants you to speak with Guard Thomas.
objectives: Marshal Dughan wants you to speak with Guard Thomas.
details: If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas. He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.
BBring me his report.
completion: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn. We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.

59.name: Cloth and Leather Armor
desc: Give Sara Timberlain the Stormwind Armor Marker.
objectives: Give Sara Timberlain the Stormwind Armor Marker.
details: For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor. I want you to take it to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp. Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you. And after you receive it, $N, use it in the defense of Elwynn.
BThe Eastvale Logging Camp is beyond Guard Thomas' post to the east.
completion: Ah, thank you for the marker. Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.
BLuck to you, brave $C. And may this armor serve you well.

83.name: Red Linen Goods
desc: Bring 6 Red Linen Bandanas to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
objectives: Bring 6 Red Linen Bandanas to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
details: The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.
BBring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.
BDefias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.
completion: Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...
BHere you are!

107.name: Note to William
desc: Take Gramma Stonefield's Note to William Pestle.
objectives: Take Gramma Stonefield's Note to William Pestle.
details: I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!
BHere, take this note to William. He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
completion: My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe. I remember being young and in love, once.
BThere must be something I can do to help them! Let me think...

131.name: Delivering Daffodils
desc: Give Darcy the Daffodil Bouquet.
objectives: Give Darcy the Daffodil Bouquet.
details: Here is your bouquet. I chose Daffodils for you. They're my favorite!
completion: Oh, those are lovely! I can't wait to put them in some water!

BBut...these are Martie's favorite flowers. Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he? You didn't tell her who they were for, did you? If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.
BOh, but it's not your fault. Thank you, and here's your meal.

155.name: The Defias Brotherhood
desc: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood. Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.
objectives: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood. Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.
details: So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny $r like you to protect me? Guess you'll have to do. Better bring some friends too.

BYou know the deal, right? You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout. But you better be close by my side. The Defias gang wants my head now. If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.
BLet me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
completion: Most excellent, $N! VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.

179.name: Dwarven Outfitters
desc: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
objectives: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
details: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?
BI'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.
BI need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
completion: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.

203.name: The Second Rebellion
desc: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters.
Return to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
objectives: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters.
BReturn to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
details: We're fighting a losing battle with Colonel Kurzen. Not only is he a brilliant tactician, he outnumbers us at least 10 to 1! To survive, we need to use his own, covert tactics against him.
BEnter his camp to the east and kill his men. Lots of them. And get out before reinforcements can close on you.
completion: Well done. The loss of those Jungle Fighters will relieve some of the pressure on our camp.
BBut now that you've had a taste of the forces we're up against, do you still want to throw your lot in with us??

227.name: Morgan Ladimore
desc: Speak with Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
objectives: Speak with Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
details: <He searches through the shelves and comes up with a leatherbound book.>
BIf you would like to know more, you might ask Althea, she's been the one to handle the... trouble... with him of late.
completion: Morgan Ladimore? Never heard of...
BOh, you mean Mor'Ladim! I guess you haven't heard the story?

BWell, I'll give you the short version. A wandering undead calling itself Mor'Ladim has been wandering Duskwood. From what we've gathered, it appears to be the undead body of Morgan Ladimore, of whom you apparently know. He's been causing us all sorts of problems, attacking Watchmen on patrol and killing people.
B<She sizes you up.>
BYou seem to be capable enough, maybe you could lay him to rest.

251.name: Translate Abercrombie's Note
desc: Bring the Letter to Ello to Sirra Von'Indi.
objectives: Bring the Letter to Ello to Sirra Von'Indi.
details: Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi. He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.
completion: <Sirra begins translating the note...>

275.name: Blisters on The Land
desc: Kill 8 Fen Creepers, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
objectives: Kill 8 Fen Creepers, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
details: I do not know why, but a festering grows within the Wetlands. Fen Creepers have risen. They are diseased, fevered blisters on the land, and for the fever to break they must be dispatched and allowed to settle back into the marshes.
BThe Fen Creepers shamble amidst the waterways of the Wetlands.
completion: This land is soothed by your efforts, and for this I will grant you a boon.

299.name: Uncovering the Past
desc: Prospector Whelgar wants you to scour the excavation site in search of the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru.
objectives: Prospector Whelgar wants you to scour the excavation site in search of the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru.
details: Just before the invasion I uncovered a large tablet called the Goaz Stone. The translated text breaks off in 4 places. The text speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy."
BI fear we are running out of time. I am too old to go down and brave those beasts. But you are strong.

BScour the excavation site and uncover the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru. Search for them in ancient artifacts or where the soil is loose. Bring them to me so I can begin unlocking the mystery!
completion: Ah the Goaz Stone is complete! Fine work, $N. Fine work indeed. Now I can continue with the delicate translation of this Titan script. I can make out new words already! Hmm. . .it says here, "Old Gods. . .Chained Beneath the Land." This is the beginning of something epic.

323.name: Proving Your Worth
desc: Kill 15 Skeletal Raiders, 3 Skeletal Healers and 3 Skeletal Warders, and then return to Sven.
objectives: Kill 15 Skeletal Raiders, 3 Skeletal Healers and 3 Skeletal Warders, and then return to Sven.
details: Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders. I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength.
BYou have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.
completion: Your skill in combat, $N, can not be doubted. Your resolve may yet see us through to the end of Morbent Fel!

347.name: Rethban Ore
desc: Gather 5 loads of Rethban Ore and bring it to Brother Paxton in the Northshire Library.
objectives: Gather 5 loads of Rethban Ore and bring it to Brother Paxton in the Northshire Library.
details: Rethban Ore is named after the man who first found it, Bart Rethban. When smelted it's not as strong as iron, but its ore has a dark, flat color that some scribes use in their dyes. It can be found in the Rethban Caverns, north of here.

BWe usually have some in stock, but we're too busy preparing for Orc attacks to gather any. And besides...Redridge Gnolls are now living in the Rethban Caverns and their Drudgers are gathering the ore themselves.
BSo if you need some, you'll have to get it yourself.
completion: Oh, splendid! I can use this ore to make my dye, and then can finish copying The Stresses of Iron.
BThank you, $N!

371.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
desc: Executor Zygand in Brill has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 Scarlet Friars.
objectives: Executor Zygand in Brill has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 Scarlet Friars.
details: We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength. The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.
BKill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
completion: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit. But other threats loom.

395.name: Brotherhood's End
desc: Speak with Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
objectives: Speak with Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
details: Ah, I almost forgot. Alexston came while you were away, he wished to speak with you. No doubt he wishes to report the goings-on of the Defias Brotherhood to the nobles.
BA bit of advice, $N: if anyone should ask, I would provide all details but that it was your hand that slew Lescovar. Trust me. I am... acquainted... with the ways of such things.
BAnd as far as Trias goes, well, speak to no one of him... ever... if you can help it.
completion: It's good to see you, $N. I have heard that Lord Gregor Lescovar was found dead not long ago.
BIt would seem that you were successful in your mission. You have my gratitude that you have saved me, and many others, from VanCleef's revenge.

419.name: The Lost Pilot
desc: Find Pilot Hildelve.
objectives: Find Pilot Hildelve.
details: My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills. We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!
BStill convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.
BIt's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night. Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.
BPlease, $N. Find him.
completion: Here is the corpse of a dwarf -- mauled, frozen, and picked clean by mountain scavengers. Clutched in its hand is a book containing the roughly scribbled notes of Mori Hildelve. And around its frame, still in superior condition, is a Brigadier's Vest.
BThis grisly scene must have been where the Siege Engine pilot met his end.

443.name: Rot Hide Ichor
desc: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
details: Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls. Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.
BGo to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there. Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
completion: Very good. This ichor will help us understand the nature of the rot hides, and may show us their weakness...
B...if they have one.

467.name: Stonegear's Search
desc: Speak with Pilot Stonegear.
objectives: Speak with Pilot Stonegear.
details: Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should! And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!
BHe heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him. If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.
completion: Hello $N. You're here about the task I have, eh? It's good to see a young $R like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!

491.name: Wand to Bethor
desc: Take the Woven Wand to Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
objectives: Take the Woven Wand to Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
details: Thule once told me that, long ago, he and two colleagues created a magic wand, woven together from the apprentice wands each mage possessed. This wand was a symbol of their friendship, and although Thule came to despise it he could not part with it, nor could he let the others have it. So he stole the wand, and hid it in Fenris Keep.
BHere. Take the wand to Bethor Iceshard, one of Thule's friends from years past. I'm sure he will want it.
completion: ...what is this? Thule had our Woven Wand? I thought it was lost when our friendship sundered and he sided with the Lich King!
BHe must not have invoked its power, for if he had I would have sensed it. And it is good that he did not use it...
BThis is a marvelous find. You have my gratitude, $N, and will be rewarded.

515.name: Elixir of Agony
desc: Bring the Mudsnout Mixture, a Strong Troll's Blood Potion, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Bring the Mudsnout Mixture, a Strong Troll's Blood Potion, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
details: A mudsnout composite? Absolutely brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?
BLet me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.

BIn order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood potion, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad. He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents. And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!
completion: The excitement of this experiment has me feeling giddy! You have been such a great help, $N. Together we will spread death and disease to this land!

539.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
desc: Kill Foreman Bonds and 10 Hillsbrad Miners and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Kill Foreman Bonds and 10 Hillsbrad Miners and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
details: The Hillsbrad Town Registry indicates that the Azureload Mine is under Alliance control. Furthermore, the mine is a prime source of iron ore for the Alliance armories.
BEven though we've struck a decisive blow to the town of Hillsbrad, the Alliance still supports and protects the Azureload Mine fervently.
BThe mine lies due south of Hillsbrad. Go there and slay the foreman, a human by the name of Bonds. Kill his miners as well. That should send a clear message to the Alliance.
completion: The Dark Lady will be pleased when she learns that she has a new mine from which she can arm her soldiers.

563.name: Reassignment
desc: Deliver Farren's report to Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.
objectives: Deliver Farren's report to Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.
details: It shouldn't be a problem getting my report seen. The new captain of the guard, Major Samuelson, was my mentor while I was stationed in Stormwind. It should give him more than enough excuse to have me transferred back to the city. I'll need you to carry my report to him, though... wouldn't want ol' Redpath to catch on.
completion: What's this? Ah... so my attentive pupil has applied himself to the problem of the naga in Southshore. Thank you for bringing this to me, I will certainly take it into account when I review personnel assignments in the next month.

587.name: Up to Snuff
desc: Deeg in Booty Bay wants you to bring him 15 shares of Snuff.
objectives: Deeg in Booty Bay wants you to bring him 15 shares of Snuff.
details: Ah, the sea life. I ain't gonna say it's the good life, but it's my life.
BWhen I get into port I like to find me a good bottle of grog and some high quality snuff. Nasty habits but what's a pirate without his vices, right?
BSo you can imagine how heartbroken I was to find out the herbalist here in town has gone and sold out of the stuff. Says his shipment got hijacked by those damned Bloodsail Raiders.
BI bet a fearless $c like you could convince 'em to share the goods, eh?
completion: Good show, $N! And just before I need to ship out too! Can't thank you enough, old friend.

611.name: The Curse of the Tides
desc: Destroy the Altar of the Tides with Catelyn's Blade, kill Gazban and bring the Stone of the Tides and Catelyn's Blade back to Baron Revilgaz.
objectives: Destroy the Altar of the Tides with Catelyn's Blade, kill Gazban and bring the Stone of the Tides and Catelyn's Blade back to Baron Revilgaz.
details: So you're looking for an altar of some sort? Well, I'm no expert on troll ruins like my father, but I have heard about a sunken troll city out near that island you're looking for. Maybe you should try there.
BYou got my knife back for me, so I guess you can borrow it... but I want it back when you're done!
completion: Amazing! The Stone of Tides! It shall have a place of prominence in my collection of ancient troll artifacts. Did you see how it almost seems as though a tide is trapped within its surface? Magnificent!

635.name: Crystal in the Mountains
desc: Find the crystal from your vision.
objectives: Find the crystal from your vision.
details: This shard pulses as you hold it...
BYou feel a sense of pleading coming from the shard, as if someone is trying to communicate, someone who desperately needs your help.
BA vision appears in your mind - of the northern mountains of Arathi, and of a brilliant crystal jutting from the earth there.
BYou feel drawn to that place.
completion: This crystal pulses, as if a living force is trapped within it.

659.name: Hints of a New Plague?
desc: Find Quae and Kinelory near the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands.
objectives: Find Quae and Kinelory near the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands.
details: Hail, and well met, $N. I lead a group of adventurers investigating odd happenings in this area.
BMy cousin in Hillsbrad recently put down his dog Stanley because the animal mystically grew to an immense size and savagely attacked anyone who came near him.
BI believe the undead are involved, and we're looking for signs to prove as much.
BTwo of my companions, Quae and Kinelory, headed to the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands, and haven't checked in for days. Find them for me? I grow concerned.
completion: Try and stay as quiet as possible, traveler.
BOrcs don't take too well to being spied on, and there is more to this farm than meets the eye.

683.name: Sara Balloo's Plea
desc: Take Sara Balloo's note to King Magni Bronzebeard of Ironforge.
objectives: Take Sara Balloo's note to King Magni Bronzebeard of Ironforge.
details: $n, I have but a small request to ask of you.

BTake this note I have prepared to our great monarch of Ironforge, King Magni Bronzebeard. 'Tis a small task to ask of one such as yourself, someone who has shown great valor to the cause of the Alliance thus far.
BFor me to go before the King in my grief-ridden state would not serve the purpose of my cause. Surely you understand.
completion: It will take but a moment for me to peruse this letter...

707.name: Ironband Wants You!
desc: Speak with Prospector Ironband at Ironband's Excavation Site in Loch Modan.
objectives: Speak with Prospector Ironband at Ironband's Excavation Site in Loch Modan.
details: $N. I received reports from Prospector Ironband at his excavation site in Loch Modan--he needs some legwork done concerning another of our excavations.
BI don't have more details than that, but if you want to stretch your legs then go speak with Ironband.
completion: So Stormpike sent you, did he? Good.
BI have a big task for you...

731.name: The Absent Minded Prospector
desc: Protect Prospector Remtravel as he searches for the mysterious fossil, then return to Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine.
objectives: Protect Prospector Remtravel as he searches for the mysterious fossil, then return to Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine.
details: So then, Hollee... oh that's right, you are not Hollee. Where's Hollee?

BBah, that's beside the point. We must find that stone brush... I mean the mysterious fossil! We must find that fossil. The Explorers' League in Darnassus will want some indication as to what I've been doing.
BLet me know when you are ready and we will hunt down that brush.... I mean fossil! We shall find something in writing to satisfy the League.
BSo are you ready yet?
completion: Thank the stars Prospector Remtravel is safe! I told you he was absent minded. I can't believe he insisted on staying there with all of those horrible creatures lurking about.

755.name: Rites of the Earthmother
desc: Travel to Seer Graytongue who lives in the hills directly south of Camp Narache.
objectives: Travel to Seer Graytongue who lives in the hills directly south of Camp Narache.
details: Your willingness to perform a humble task for the tauren of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, $n. I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a $c of greatness.
BBefore that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.
BThe first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.
BYou will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.
completion: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...

827.name: Skull Rock
desc: Gather Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock.
Bring them to Margoz at his camp.
objectives: Gather Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock.
BBring them to Margoz at his camp.
details: $N. The Burning Blade has infested the cave east of Orgrimmar known as Skull Rock. Inside that cave they perform vile rituals, and burn their own flesh with Searing Collars.
BBy wearing these collars, I believe the cultists attune themselves to demonic power. But to confirm this, I must have a collection of the collars to study.
BGo to Skull Rock and gather Searing Collars from the cultists you find there. Bring them to me, and I will uncover their secrets.
completion: Good. Hiding within these collars is the secret behind the Burning Blade. And I will uncover that secret...

851.name: Verog the Dervish
desc: Bring Verog's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
objectives: Bring Verog's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
details: The centaur Verog the Dervish wanders the Barrens, and will be difficult to find. But he is based at the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast. It may be possible to draw him to you.
BTravel to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast and attack centaur near the command tent. It will be dangerous, but if you can kill enough centaur then they should raise an alarm. And Verog will come.
BBring me his head and I will place it with Barak Kodobane's.
completion: Very good. You must have really stirred up those centaur -- our guards spotted activity down near the Stagnant Oasis, which was probably you.
BYou should be proud of your deed, $N. There is much bravery in you.

875.name: Harpy Lieutenants
desc: Collect 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings from Witchwing Slayers and return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
objectives: Collect 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings from Witchwing Slayers and return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
details: Hahaha, $n. Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.

BThis time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.
BMake sure they die painfully, $n. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.
completion: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the Horde.

899.name: Consumed by Hatred
desc: Bring 60 Bristleback Quilboar Tusks to Mankrik at the Crossroads.
objectives: Bring 60 Bristleback Quilboar Tusks to Mankrik at the Crossroads.
details: Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, $c. But know this: I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.
BYou, $c--you could help me.
BKill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
completion: $C, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.
BAlthough my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.

923.name: Tumors
desc: Bring 5 Mossy Tumors to Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus.
objectives: Bring 5 Mossy Tumors to Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus.
details: There is a malevolence growing in the timberlings. We are trying to find the source, but until we do...in order to keep Teldrassil safe we must cut down the timberlings who are beyond help. Those that wander Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil are the most tainted. They must be removed!
BDestroy the Timberlings you find there, and gather the mossy tumors growing upon them. Bring the tumors to me so that they may be burned.
completion: Well done! These tumors are the symptom of the timberling's disease. They are filled with a poison that we must cleanse from our new land.
BI will dispose of these tumors. Thank you, $N.

947.name: Cave Mushrooms
desc: Bring 5 Scaber Stalks and 1 Death Cap to Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine.
objectives: Bring 5 Scaber Stalks and 1 Death Cap to Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine.
details: I am devising a potion that requires rare mushrooms, mushrooms that grow only in a certain cave. The cave lies behind Cliffspring Falls, to the east and slightly north along the mountains.
BI would go there myself, but I was advised by the Grove of the Ancients to stay away from that place. Our venerable allies sense that the cave is the hiding place for a new evil in Darkshore.
BPlease, $N, gather the mushrooms for me. And while doing so, scout the cave to confirm the Ancients' fears.
completion: Many thanks, $N. These mushrooms are fine specimens!
BAnd when you were at Cliffspring Falls, did you find anything to confirm the warnings of the Ancients?
BThe Ancients are wise, but I had hoped that, this time, they were wrong.

971.name: Knowledge in the Deeps
desc: Bring the Lorgalis Manuscript to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring the Lorgalis Manuscript to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge.
details: As you might know, I collect lore. Old lore. Powerful lore. Lore that opens doorways, and lore that can awaken Those Who Sleep.

BThere are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale. That place is the old dwelling of long-dead elves. Elves who held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.
BSearch Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript. Do this, and I will not forget it. Not even after ... the end days.
completion: You found the manuscript! What a joyous day this is! Copies will be made and distributed, and the ancient knowledge of Lorgalis will finally be known to my brothers and sisters!
BYour service to us is more than you know, $N. But I hope that this gift shows you the gratitude we extend to our allies.

995.name: Escape Through Stealth
desc: Escape the Furbolg cave and meet Terenthis in Auberdine.
objectives: Escape the Furbolg cave and meet Terenthis in Auberdine.
details: All right then... if you're sure, we'll sneak out of here. Let us leave when you're ready.
BRemember, after you've escaped, meet Terenthis back in Auberdine. I'll head there on my own since I'll probably be moving faster than you.
completion: $N! I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in Darkshore and beyond.

1019.name: The New Frontier
desc: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
details: Attention, heroes!

BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
completion: What makes you think I wish to be pestered by the likes of you, $C? Wait - let me stop the important duties I attend to on a daily basis so I can help you locate a doodad somewhere. By all means, the welfare of Darnassus - nay, all of Teldrassil - should come second to the acquisition of a bauble for your collection.
BThe fools in Moonglade waste my time with their call for assistance, and now I must endure this?

1043.name: The Scythe of Elune
desc: Look for signs of the Scythe of Elune then return to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.
objectives: Look for signs of the Scythe of Elune then return to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.
details: Your story rings true... I do not entirely understand your motives, but if your business here in Duskwood involves ridding the forest of worgen in any number, then I can forgo understanding for results.
BThere is a mine to the south that has been overrun with worgen... They appeared out of nowhere, but from what we know, that is where they first were found.
BGo about your business, but I would ask that if you find anything of import, you share it with me. We will accept any aid in our war against evil.
completion: It is an interesting story you tell, $N. Though the Carevin family's influence is not large enough that we might find the root of these troubles and finish them once and for all, we will do what we can to contain the worgens' numbers in Duskwood.
BAlready I have instructed Calor to make this his first priority.

1067.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
desc: Bring Lydon's Toxin to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Bring Lydon's Toxin to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff.
details: Here is the toxin. If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results. I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!
BBut before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah. She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.
completion: A toxin from Apothecary Lydon? Very good. If I know Lydon, then this toxin will be quite effective against the Venture Company...

1091.name: Kaela's Update
desc: Bring the Venture Co. Letters to Kaela Shadowspear.
objectives: Bring the Venture Co. Letters to Kaela Shadowspear.
details: $N, take these letters to Kaela. I'm sure she'll want to know about this. Or at least the Sentinels will.
BMake sure you tell her how successful we were and how we couldn't have done it without a little bit of magic.
completion: This is interesting indeed.
BYou and Gaxim have done very well, $N. Thank you.

1115.name: The Rumormonger
desc: Talk to Krazek in Booty Bay.
objectives: Talk to Krazek in Booty Bay.
details: Now that we've done a service for the gnomes, it's time to do the goblins a favor!
BI hear that the goblin racer pilot, Nazz Steamboil, didn't always use that name. I wonder why he changed it. I wonder if it's a secret, and... I wonder if he values that secret.
BIf anyone knows the truth, then it's Krazek of Booty Bay, on the southern tip of Stranglethorn. Speak with Krazek and ask him about our goblin pilot.
BIf you can get useful information from him, then we might just turn a profit from it.
completion: You want to know about Nazz Steamboil? He's a racer pilot out in the Shimmering Flats, isn't he?
BYeah, I might be able to find something out about him... but it won't be easy. Or fast.
BOr cheap.

1139.name: The Lost Tablets of Will
desc: Find the Tablet of Will, and return them to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
objectives: Find the Tablet of Will, and return them to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
details: We've slowed the Shadowforge clan by cutting them off from Blackrock Spire, but Hammertoe's quest is still unfulfilled. His death must not be in vain. He dreamt of finding the Tablet of Will: a stone shard inscribed with magic by the titans themselves to help imbue their creations with life--making them have a will of their own, or so the legends say.
BWe must still recover the Tablet before the Shadowforge clan finds it.
BReturn to Uldaman, find the tablet, and return here immediately.
completion: <Advisor Belgrum shakes his head in disbelief as you hand him the stone shard.>

B$N, this is amazing. I shall have this brought to the king's mages as soon as possible. They will want to study it to find out if the legends are true. But that is a discussion for another time: you have aided our people more than I would have ever expected--thank you.

1187.name: Razzeric's Tweaking
desc: Retrieve the Seaforium Booster for Razzeric in the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Retrieve the Seaforium Booster for Razzeric in the Shimmering Flats.
details: Pozzik's a great mechanic, I know that, but he's afraid to just load on the firepower and grab on for the ride. Not me, though.
BAfter Pozzik finishes with a racer, I take a little time to put my own modifications on--you know, loosening up the controls, removing parts of the frame, and adding more juice!
BI ordered a seaforium booster from Shreev at the Gizmorium in Gadgetzan, but apparently the zeppelin it was being sent on crashed in Dustwallow Marsh! I gotta have it, $n!
completion: Just take a look at this beauty! Fifteen pounds of solid seaforium power! Once I get this strapped on to the side of my racer, I'll be around the track so fast I'll beat the gnomes twice!

1259.name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
desc: Find out more about Reethe from Adjutant Tesoran in Theramore.
objectives: Find out more about Reethe from Adjutant Tesoran in Theramore.
details: I don't recognize the name of Lieutenant Paval Reethe. Your best bet would be to check with Adjutant Tesoran. He keeps track of all the records for the Theramore guard, from personnel to their equipment.
BHe should be able to tell you who this Reethe is with a quick check of his books.
completion: Hello, $N. You'd like information about a specific member of the Theramore guard? Reethe, was it?
BJust give me a moment to find the right book.

1427.name: Threat From the Sea
desc: Speak with Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
objectives: Speak with Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
details: Before you take rest, speak to Tok'Kar again. While you were gone I believe he finished a few weapons. For your help here, he would offer one of them to you. You would do well to test its strength against the fish men when you are ready... but only to please me further.
completion: Ah, $N, you've returned. Good. I've finished crafting more weapons for our fight against the murlocs. For bringing us the fresh sawtooth meat, and for bringing a small smile to Katar's face, I offer one of them to you.

1451.name: Rhapsody Shindigger
desc: Seek out Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands.
objectives: Seek out Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands.
details: Rhapsody took quite a liking to the booze. Now don't get me wrong -- all of us dwarves up here at the aviary love a good ale when the time is right.
BBut ol' Shindigger took to the liquor like a gryphon takes to the skies. And a damned shame it was, too. No one could fly like Rhapsody.
BFirst sign of trouble was when he came stumbling back from that mission with your buddy, Brohann. All went down hill quickly after that. Had to let him go.
BLast I heard, he's set up a brew camp to the east of here...
completion: Hiccup!
BI'm a-lookin' right at you but you keep bobbing up and down. Makin' me dizzy. Hoho!
BHiccup!
BWhoa! Did ya feel that? Ground is a-shakin', my friend. I need a drink.
BHiccup!

1475.name: Into The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
desc: Gather 10 Atal'ai Tablets for Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
objectives: Gather 10 Atal'ai Tablets for Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
details: According to legend, The Temple of Atal'Hakkar is a holy shrine dedicated to the ancient god, Hakkar the Soulflayer. Maintained by a vicious tribe of trolls named the Atal'ai, the temple is rumored to be impenetrable.
BNow sunk beneath the Pool of Tears, retrieving artifacts from the temple is even more difficult. But that's what I need you to do, $n.
BAid me by gathering the intact Atal'ai Tablets. Bring them to me and I will return to the Explorers' Guild a hero. Together we will share the glory.
completion: The Atal'ai Tablets! Thank you, $N!
BOnce I deliver these to the Explorers' League our names shall go down in history together. You have helped an old dwarf fulfill his final obligation in life. For that I am eternally grateful.

1499.name: Vile Familiars
desc: Speak with Zureetha Fargaze.
objectives: Speak with Zureetha Fargaze.
details: Zureetha has been sending novices like yourself to help cull the numbers of the creatures in the cave near where you fought the vile familiars.
BI think it would be good for you to gain experience by assisting her. Be sure to tell her that you assisted with the imp problem, she'll probably have a reward for you.
completion: You have done well, $n.
BAlthough the vile familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.

1523.name: Call of Fire
desc: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
objectives: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
details: Long has it been since you were last tested, $N. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about destruction... and chaos. The element of fire is yours for the understanding, if you're prepared to pay for it.
BSeek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the night elf lands, you've gone too far.
completion: Hmmm, Narm sent you to me, did he?
BWell then, Narm could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.

BI see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. Patience, $N. Remember what earth taught you. Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.

1643.name: The Tome of Divinity
desc: Search the Trade District of Stormwind for Stephanie Turner.
objectives: Search the Trade District of Stormwind for Stephanie Turner.
details: Your task then, $N, is to find someone here in Stormwind that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.
BDo this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light.
completion: Oh, hello, luv. How go your adventures? Oh, I'm so glad to hear you're doing well.
BOh, me? Thank you for asking--I'm doing well, all things considered.

BThe increase in tradesmen has kind of put a damper on the amount of leather and cloth people are willing to part with these days, so it's been tougher to make clothing for the children at the orphanage, but we'll manage. By "we" I mean my husband and I. He's up in Ironforge trying to seek help from the citizens there.

1667.name: Dead-tooth Jack
desc: Retrieve Haggard's Badge from Dead-tooth Jack's camp, and return to Marshal Haggard.
objectives: Retrieve Haggard's Badge from Dead-tooth Jack's camp, and return to Marshal Haggard.
details: Burlguard sent you, did he? Yes, I have spare weapons around here, but first I have a task for you...

BA while ago a Defias villain Dead-tooth Jack tricked me. It was dark and he was wearing a Stormwind tabard and I thought he was Marshal Dughan. He said he needed my old Stormwind Marshal's badge and I gave it to him... and then he laughed and ran off before I could catch him!
BGet back my badge! Dead-tooth Jack probably has it stowed in his camp to the south.
completion: Great, you found it! I feared it was gone forever, used by the Defias to impersonate a Stormwind official. Well that won't happen now, thanks to you.
BHere are some weapons I used when I was a Marshal. I kept them in great shape--take your pick!

1691.name: More Wastewander Justice
desc: Take down 10 Wastewander Shadow Mages, 8 Wastewander Rogues, and 6 Wastewander Assassins for Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Take down 10 Wastewander Shadow Mages, 8 Wastewander Rogues, and 6 Wastewander Assassins for Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.$B
details: We need you to take on the stronger ranks of the Wastewander nomads now. You've done a good job thus far, but if we are to take back those water wells, then it only makes sense to do it against as few nomads as possible!
BThis time around we need you to take down their rogues, assassins, and shadow mages. You'll find them east and southeast of here.
BI'm not going to lie to you - they're a nasty lot. Do this for us though, and we'll be on our way to taking back what is rightfully ours!
completion: Top notch work, $N... top notch! You've thinned down the nomad population to a point where we can actually take the fight to them!
BIf you haven't already, talk to Spigot Operator Luglunket here; he gives a bounty on any of the Wastewander water pouches you may have run across while bringing those nomads to justice!

1715.name: The Slaughtered Lamb
desc: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
objectives: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
details: Hmph. Times past, all warlocks in Khaz Modan were trained under the auspices of the masters of Gnomeregan, but now that we've all been forced to relocate into this rat's hole in Ironforge, and Magni's decided to keep a careful watch on us, we're forced to send our novices to Stormwind for training.
BLuckily, Gakin's no slouch, so you'll still learn what you need to know, but it burns my blood!
BAnyways, you'll find Gakin in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind.
completion: Sent by Blackwrench, were you? Damn warlocks in Ironforge need to get things sorted out. There's only so much room and so many teachers in Stormwind. With all the increased traffic, we're sure to attract attention sooner or later.

1739.name: The Binding
desc: Using the Heartswood Core, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Heartswood Core to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
objectives: Using the Heartswood Core, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Heartswood Core to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
details: Using the heartswood core, you will be able to cast a spell at the summoning circle in the crypt below to open a portal for the succubus to pass through.
BBe careful, $n, succubi have overrun even the strongest of minds.
BOnce you have bested and returned it to the void, return to me and I will show you how to call and control it.
completion: Well done, well done, $N. I see we've done right in deciding to train you. Your performance certainly does not disappoint.
BI've no qualms in showing you the way to control your newly bound succubus. Observe carefully.

1787.name: The Tome of Divinity
desc: Retrieve a Defias Script from the Defias Rogue Wizards in Elwynn, and return to Gazin Tenorm in Stormwind.
objectives: Retrieve a Defias Script from the Defias Rogue Wizards in Elwynn, and return to Gazin Tenorm in Stormwind.
details: We'll have time to talk more about the Symbol at a later time. What's important now is to get those papers we saw the Defias going over. If we can get our hands on them, we'll be able to prove the Defias have infiltrated Elwynn and hopefully gain some insight into what their plans are.
BI'm in no shape for battle as of now, $N. Do you think you're strong enough to get those papers from the Defias here on the island?
BIf you're able to get them, bring them back to Gazin and let him know I'm all right.
completion: Wonderful! You made it, and saved Henze. The Light is with you for sure, $N!

1859.name: Therzok
desc: Speak with Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak with Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
details: Lower your voice, $n. Yeah, I know your name. Was told to keep an eye out for an orc by your description.
BFrom what we've heard about you, you can handle yourself in combat, and aren't opposed to a little sneakery from time to time.
BAm I right?
BAnyways, you should go see Therzok in Orgrimmar. He's got an offer for you to hear.
completion: Very good, I'm glad Kaplak was able to get a hold of you.
BWe have some things to speak of, not the least of which is your future with the Hand.

1883.name: Speak with Un'thuwa
desc: Speak with Un'thuwa.
objectives: Speak with Un'thuwa.
details: Un'thuwa, tribal mage of Sen'jin Village, detects a disturbance in the magic currents of Durotar and asks for aid. Speak with Un'thuwa and do what you can to help him.
BDo this, and in time further secrets will be revealed to you.
completion: Hail, $N. Praise to you, for my call for aid is now answered. Let us hope you are up to the task...

1955.name: The Exorcism
desc: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.
objectives: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.
details: Now that we have a summoner's orb, we must exorcise the demon within it. I can do that. That's the easy part.
BYou're the one who has the hard job. You're the one who has to kill the demon once it's out.
BAnd you'll have to be quick. If you take too long then he'll jump back in the orb and we'll have to start over!
BSo get yourself ready. Prepare your strongest spells and keep your potions handy, and go get a friend if you have one. Because this isn't going to be pretty.
completion: Nicely done, $N! You gave that demon a lesson he won't soon forget.

BHe'll think twice before he sticks his ugly head back in this world, looking for the stupid mortal who beat him. Probably with friends this time. Big, scaly friends who'd want nothing more than to tear you into little $R pieces.
BI didn't scare you, did I...$N?

2339.name: Find the Gems and Power Source
desc: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman.
From the journal, you know...
* The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.
* The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some Alliance dwarves.
* The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.
objectives: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman.

BFrom the journal, you know...$B* The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.$B* The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some Alliance dwarves.$B* The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.
details: Here is the journal, translated for you to read on your own. The crux of it says dwarves hid the ruby, the troggs hid the topaz, and a trogg named Grimlok has the sapphire.

BLook - you're going to need a power source to make the necklace work again. Dran Droffers doesn't know this. To find one, here's what I'd do: go as deep as you can in Uldaman and kill whatever construct there is the strongest. No doubt whatever that is would have it.
BWhen you have everything collected, come back here!
completion: Very well done, $C. Now the fruits of our redirection will pay themselves out handsomely. I'm finished with the necklace itself, and I am confident I can duplicate the construction process consistently.
BBut first, I will use a specially prepared incantation to quickly analyze those gems before you take them and the necklace back to Orgrimmar. This will take just a brief moment to do.

2459.name: Ferocitas the Dream Eater
desc: Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar wants you to kill 7 Gnarlpine Mystics and find the Missing Jewel.
objectives: Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar wants you to kill 7 Gnarlpine Mystics and find the Missing Jewel.
details: The emerald... It is missing! My dreamcatcher has been damaged!

BThere is a band of Gnarlpine mystics located to the north of Starbreeze. I have heard reports that their leader, Ferocitas the Dream Eater has been wearing a necklace that glows green in the night. Now seeing my dreamcatcher, I am sure that he has stolen my emerald... He would never realize that its power is useless to him.
BFind this missing jewel, $N. And, while you're there, clear out some of the corrupted mystics as well.
completion: Now I can repair my dreamcatcher. Thank you, $N.

2603.name: Vulture's Vigor
desc: Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two Snickerfang Jowls to Bloodmage Lynnore.
objectives: Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two Snickerfang Jowls to Bloodmage Lynnore.$B
details: Death does indeed have wings in these blasted lands, $r. I have witnessed the black slayers and bonepickers feasting upon the corpse of many a fallen explorer - sometimes feeding upon the most vile and disease ridden of carcasses. It is a wonder, then, how their internal systems overcome the pestilence that claims these lands.
BAssist me in my studies, $N! Gizzards I need! Two snickerfang jowls will also be required for the base of the concoction.
BYou shall be rewarded two-fold for your efforts.
completion: Most excellent! I shall get to work immediately. Perhaps a cure for many of the ailments of the world is to be found!
BAh yes, your reward - of course, should you require more of the gum, return to me and another task you shall be given.

2771.name: A Good Head On Your Shoulders
desc: Bring two Mithril Coifs and one Ornate Mithril Shoulder to Trenton Lighthammer.
objectives: Bring two Mithril Coifs and one Ornate Mithril Shoulder to Trenton Lighthammer.
details: It seems as if master had this planned from the start. I was not taught to create the items which you learned to create and you were not taught the items which I learned to create.
BThe master is wise, $N. We shall teach each other!
BShow me how to make a mithril coif and ornate mithril shoulders and I shall show you how to create an ornate mithril helm.
completion: Excellent! A fair tradeoff, if I do say so myself. Watch and learn, $N!

2843.name: Gnomer-gooooone!
desc: Wait for Scooty to calibrate the Goblin Transponder.
objectives: Wait for Scooty to calibrate the Goblin Transponder.
details: As long as you have the transponder in your possession, all you need to do is step on the pad and you'll be teleported to Gnomeregan.
BYou may experience some unusual side effects, but none of those should be permanent... anymore.
BI almost forgot the most important part - getting back. When you're ready to come back, just step on the transpolyporter pad in Gnomeregan!
BNow to calibrate the transponder to your size and weight.$B
completion: All done! When you're ready, just step on the pad.

2867.name: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold
desc: Return to Shandris Feathermoon in the Feathermoon Stronghold and report your findings.
objectives: Return to Shandris Feathermoon in the Feathermoon Stronghold and report your findings.
details: With the discovery of the strange gazebo in the heart of the Ruins of Solarsal, the time has come to return to Feathermoon Stronghold and report to General Shandris Feathermoon what has been discovered here.
completion: Welcome back, $N. Your report on this gazebo is most... disturbing. It would seem that even if the naga there were not planning on an attack, their continued presence bodes ill for our push into Feralas. At any rate, here is compensation for your investigation.
BIt would seem that Feathermoon Stronghold is in dire need of additional assistance concerning the Hatecrest naga. I'd like to offer you the task, if you are so inclined. There is much to do.

2939.name: In Search of Knowledge
desc: Talk to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.
objectives: Talk to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.
details: While the ruins of Feralas can be quite dangerous, they have much to tell of what has happened here.

BSearching through the rubble to the south a few days ago, I discovered what appears to be a normal stave. However, I just can't shake the feeling that there is something more to it. Angelas and I have been poring over our books here, but we can't find a thing about it.
BI have a colleague in Darnassus that may be able to tell us what this is, $N. Why don't you go talk to her and see if she can help us?
completion: Oh, so Troyas Moonbreeze sent you?
B<mutters>...always bothering me with his wild notions that he found something important...

BLook, $N, I'll be blunt. Troyas always thinks he has found something important in those ruins. The truth is, anything that was truly valuable was probably hoarded away long ago by the ogres or the harpies that now reside there.
BYou're welcome to take a look around, but I don't know if you'll find any books here that will help you.

2963.name: Portents of Uldum
desc: Speak with Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers within Ironforge.
objectives: Speak with Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers within Ironforge.
details: Greetings once again, $n! Your discovery inside Uldaman has set the Explorers' League abuzz with excitement. The League has been working to unlock the secrets of the miniature platinum discs you found. Your fortuitous arrival here in the Hall allows me to share with you that we are quite possibly on to something!
BHistorian Karnik has uncovered some important clues as to the true origins of the Valley of the Watchers in the Tanaris desert. He would like to speak with you as soon as possible!
completion: I am glad you're maintaining your interest in exploration, $N! With your natural talent and moxie, we could crack open secrets that we never thought were possible!

BThe Discs of Norgannon in Uldaman were a repository of vast information; you were only permitted to access the top layers, as it were, of the information stored there. The Creators were rumored to have more repositories located throughout Azeroth. This now brings us to Uldum...

2987.name: Gordunni Cobalt
desc: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
objectives: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
details: I just arrived here in Feralas, and I've heard that the Gordunni Ogres that inhabit the wilds here have some interesting minerals. Who knows what they are up to, but they sure are protective of that stuff! They don't leave it just lying around; no, they bury it to protect folks like me from getting their hands on it.
BIf you'd be willing, I'll give you my shovel. Go to the Gordunni Outpost north of here and dig me up some Gordunni cobalt. Look for the blue glow, then start digging!
completion: Perfect! I will take these along as I continue my travels, $N. I'm sure I can find someone that will pay a pretty penny for this cobalt.
BHere, take this for your trouble.

3083.name: Encrypted Tablet
desc: Read the Encrypted Tablet and speak to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
objectives: Read the Encrypted Tablet and speak to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
details: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.
BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the rogue trainer Rwag. He would have words with you when you're ready.
completion: Until such time comes, you'll be under my tutelage. I will show you the ropes as some folks say. Whenever you feel prepared, come to me and I will see about training you further. Until then, practice your skills and keep them honed to a razor's edge. You'll never know when you'll need even the most insignificant ability.

3107.name: Consecrated Rune
desc: Read the Consecrated Rune and speak to Bromos Grummner in Coldridge Valley.
objectives: Read the Consecrated Rune and speak to Bromos Grummner in Coldridge Valley.
details: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the paladin trainer Bromos. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
completion: The humans have taught us a great deal about the Holy Light and how important their order is to them... and to protecting all of Azeroth. We have a great respect for how stepped in tradition it is, and how just one figure, one sacrifice, can make the difference between pain and salvation.

BThe two of us are gonna be working together for a bit. Any time you think you're ready, come back to me and we'll see about getting you some training. Can't have you go out into the world unprepared, now, can we?

3371.name: Dwarven Justice
desc: Return to the Searing Gorge and find Dorius's archaeology unit.
objectives: Return to the Searing Gorge and find Dorius's archaeology unit.
details: There is an empty, vacuous hole, where my heart used to be, $N. The loss of Dorius is not one that I will soon recover from. I must see his final wish through - the perpetrators of this cold blooded murder must be brought to justice.
BReturn to the Searing Gorge and fulfill his last request: Free his men. The Dark Iron dwarves force their slaves to work in a sweltering mine called the Slag Pits. Search there for Dorius' men.
completion: Forget about me, help the others.

3443.name: Forging the Shaft
desc: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.
objectives: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.
details: To hold the flawless flame, we will need a shaft and a casing. You must first find a suitable shaft.

BThe Dark Iron taskmasters and slavers of the cauldron use weapons of enchanted thorium, an extremely sturdy alloy. If you bring me eight thorium plated daggers, I can break the alloy down and reforge a shaft.$B
completion: You're an exceptional laborer, $N. Have you ever considered a change of vocation? Perhaps a detective? Junk collector? Oh, I know, one of those silly gnomes that crawl across the beaches of Azeroth with their metal detecting contraptions, looking for lost treasure. Yes, that would be an ideal position for you.

3563.name: Jes'rimon's Payment to Jediga
desc: Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
objectives: Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
details: Take this letter to Jediga. Let her know that our deal has been beneficial and I be pleased with her work.
BYou tell her she come back to Orgrimmar fast and Jes'rimon make sure he take good care of her.
BTell her that, and maybe in the future I have need of your services again, $N.
completion: I can see he was more than pleased by the looks of his note.... a little too pleased.
BPerhaps some day I'll take time to make sure he knows how much I appreciate his advances also. Well, at least there's one reason to look forward to spending more time in Azshara.
BHere's your share of our payment.

3635.name: Gnome Engineering
desc: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
objectives: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
details: Engineering at the expert level breaks into two disciplines: gnome and goblin. While I think it is a waste, you should be aware of gnome specialization. They make items and gadgets that claim to change the world, but rarely work.

B$N, read this manual. If you wish to learn how to make metal paper weights, then take the manual to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay. Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure you are sure before finishing his task.
completion: You've come to learn about gnome engineering, eh? Well, you've come to the right gnome. While the ruling faction of Gnomeregan may use politics to ostracize those they view as an intellectual threat, they know that knowledge is something they cannot control.
BThey and I both know that when I left Gnomeregan, they lost one of their greatest gnome engineers alive today. If you're a capable student, I'll teach you what I know.

3923.name: Rilli Greasygob
desc: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.
details: Well, that didn't work. I put some extra gauges on the samophlange to measure its structural integrity, and they read the integrity at an all-time low. I could add some more dials and maybe a lever or two to try and fix it, but... I think that might make things even worse.
BYou should take the samophlange to Rilli Greasygob. He used to work for the Venture Company -- if anyone knows how to fix it, it's Rilli.
BYou can find him at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar, in the Valley of Honor.
completion: What's this? Why, it's a samophlange! Where did you get this thing? Have you been poking around the Venture Company holdings in the Barrens?
BYou must be very brave, or very stupid.

4283.name: FIFTY! YEP!
desc: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.
details: I'm going to let you in on a little secret, soldier. Come a little closer.
BI'M THE ONLY SANE ONE HERE!
BLook at these people! Would you believe that they're all insane!? Well they are! NUTS! CRAZY!
B<Oralius lowers his voice.>
BLet's just keep that between me, you, and my pal Captain Winky.
B<Oralius grabs at the air and squeezes.>
BAnyhooooo... I'm collecting badges to go along with my ogre ear collection. Orc is the flavor of the day. Fifty. GO!
B<Oralius blows into a horn.>
BSHIP IT!
completion: You've done it! Your reward is: RUB MY BELLY! GO ON! RUB IT!

4451.name: The Key to Freedom
desc: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.
objectives: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.
details: The small brass key looks simple enough.. The only thing that seems to make it stand out are some words scratched into the head of it:
B"Dark Iron Outhouse - Do Not Duplicate."
BYou have no idea what it means or what it will lead to.
completion: Well, I'll be! How in tarnation!? You found the key! I knew them blasted Dark Irons were hiding it after they locked me in here! Thank ya so much, $N. You're the greatest! Now, just turn the key and let ol' Locheed outta here!

4739.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
desc: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
objectives: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
details: $C! Yes, you!
BYou don't have all the accoutrements, but it's plain to see you're ready--the air around you exudes greater confidence. Yes, I see it now.
BMenara Voidrender would teach you a few things if you feel you're ready. She spends her time tutoring younger students in the arcane. She even gives gifts to those who pass her tests.
BGo to Ratchet in the Barrens if you're interested. She's above the city in Strahad's tower.
completion: Ah, Kaal sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. This pleases me.

BIt is typical of our kind, $N, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.
BI feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.

4763.name: The Blackwood Corrupted
desc: Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.
Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps.
Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor.
Take the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.
objectives: Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.
BGather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps.
BMix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor.
BTake the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.
details: We've learned that a source of furbolg corruption is from the satyr. They hold sway via talismans that they channel magic through. If the furbolg have a chance at salvation, we must lure out the satyr corruptor and take that talisman!

BFill this bowl at our moonwell and take samples of the furbolgs' food from their northern camp. Mix them and place it near the bonfire by the river; any furbolgs who eat will be cleansed just long enough to lure out the satyr corruptor... who then you must slay!
completion: We have just begun this war to reclaim our forest from the forces of corruption, but a battle this day has been won! $N, the people of Auberdine owe you a debt of gratitude that will never be easily repaid. Please accept this along with our thanks. What we have learned here today may one day free our furbolg friends from the shackles of torment permanently.

4787.name: The Ancient Egg
desc: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
objectives: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
details: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of an ancient egg. It is a relic of a time when trolls ruled vast empires, and it has the power to hold the essence of Hakkar. It may be the only way to keep our world safe from his evil.
BBring me the ancient egg, $N. It is said to lay hidden deep within Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, in a cave behind the amphitheater at the top of the city.
completion: Ah, you have the egg! I bow to you, $N. Your strength and bravery will be long remembered.

4811.name: The Red Crystal
desc: Travel east of Auberdine and look for a large, red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range. Report back what you find to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
objectives: Travel east of Auberdine and look for a large, red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range. Report back what you find to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
details: Hostile moonkin roam in ever increasing numbers to our east. They once were thought to be gentle, almost mystical creatures. While some continue to hold reverence for them, the safety of Auberdine forces me to keep a more realistic view.

BI've received reports that moonkin are being drawn to a large red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range. No one has any idea what that crystal is, or even if it really exists. I want you to locate it over there and report back to me what you find.
completion: So the crystal exists, $N? Fascinating... anyway, your task has been well executed; good work!

BWhat exactly is this crystal? This is but a single question in a sea of questions. Another question that comes to mind is why the moonkin would be drawn to this object? Is the crystal benign in nature, or does it hold a more sinister purpose?
BI have many more questions, but we're going to need to examine that crystal closely to get some answers.

4883.name: Guarding Secrets
desc: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.
objectives: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.
details: While I do possess much knowledge about the owlbeasts you defeated in Winterspring, I am not very learned on the subject of the magics they wield. But I do believe I know of one that would be able to examine the necklace and most likely tell you what it is.
BNara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff is an expert in this field; see her. Good luck, $N.
completion: The energy of this necklace, $N. I believe that it has only one source.
B<Nara closes her eyes and is quiet for a moment.>
BThe wildkin, now misguided and confused, were once not so. They once had a purpose, and were guided to serve. The night elf goddess Elune created these creatures to guard her most sacred areas.
BWhile this fact may seem like it holds little value; I urge you to look deeper.
BYou will learn, in time. Thank you for bringing this to me, $N.

4907.name: Tinkee Steamboil
desc: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.
objectives: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.
details: Hi, $N. Remember Tinkee Steamboil? Well, she remembers you! She sent me a message to keep an eye out for you, because... she needs your help again. I think it has something to do with her studies on dragons.
BYou should speak to her in the Burning Steppes, at the Flame Crest.
completion: Felnok was right! I do need your help again, and this time... it's going to be really dangerous.
BAre you ready??

5051.name: Two Halves Become One
desc: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it.
Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it.
BGive the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.
details: The ramblings of the poor ghost continue:

B"I'm so cold, John. Bring me your charm, and we'll be together! Quickly John, before the plague comes to change us into hideous beasts! I can't see you John... but I know you're near. I feel you near me."
BPerhaps if the second half of the charm was found and reassembled, this would constitute what the spirit of Janice Felstone is seeking.
completion: You hand the reassembled good luck charm to Janice Felstone's ghost. As soon as she grasps it, you observe an almost immediate change in her. Her ethereal form shimmers, and she looks upon you with clear yet sad eyes.
B"You've freed me... I no longer will need this charm. Please, take it and perhaps it will give you the solace it has given me."

5123.name: The Final Piece
desc: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
objectives: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
details: The log you found on the high chief looks extensive, but after looking through a couple of the pages, you find that you cannot read the text. The markings are so crude and poorly-formed that you are not sure if anyone would be able to read them.
BBut perhaps Donova will be able to tell you what it says...
completion: I wonder what all of this means... I can't make anything out...

5147.name: Wanted - Arnak Grimtotem
desc: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.
objectives: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.
details: Wanted: Arnak Grimtotem
BArnak the outcast is wanted for the heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. Handsome rewards will be given to those brave enough to bring this criminal to justice.
BArnak was last seen on the cliffs near the Darkcloud Pinnacle. Show the proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post in order to claim the reward.
completion: Hah! Well, this is excellent news! I was starting to think that he would never be brought to justice!
BHere you are, $N... and thanks. News of Anrak's foul deeds boiled my blood!

5219.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
desc: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
objectives: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
details: One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. Well, we shall shed no tears this day as we thwart the Scourge and have them choke on their own fumes!

BGo to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there. It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you into the cauldron. Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.
completion: The macabre key found on the cauldron lord easily slides into a keyhole and then disappears, allowing you permanent access to it. Crude, viscous ichors pulsate through twisted tubes within the cauldrons underpinnings.
BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.

5243.name: Houses of the Holy
desc: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
objectives: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
details: I look at my undeath as a malady, $r. An illness that merely requires treatment; however, it is also a great blessing for the Argent Dawn. What better vessel to smite the heathens of the Scourge than through the undead?
BI am revered by my colleagues because of the sacrifices I have made, but the accolades mean nothing to me.
BIf you are interested in assisting the Argent Dawn, then a job I can offer.
BVenture to Stratholme and recover our surplus of holy water. Search the supply crates.$B
completion: Well done, $R. You have proven that while you are tolerant of others, you will stop at nothing to destroy the minions of Kel'Thuzad.
B

5507.name: Mantles of the Dawn
desc: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
details: Your service to the Argent Dawn is to be commended, $N. You are truly revered amongst us. I have been authorized to make available for you to purchase one of the Dawn's most valued items - our magic resistance mantles.

BApplication of a mantle to your existing shoulder piece will enhance your resistance to the powers of magic in one of five potential ways. As a sign of continued dedication to our cause, I ask for no less than ten of our valor tokens in exchange for access to these mantles.
completion: Outstanding - your tribute to the Dawn is duly noted, $N. With this accomplished, I am delighted to make our mantles available to you for purchase. So long as you maintain your current status with us, these mantles will be purchasable from any authorized quartermaster of the Argent Dawn.
BFor the Dawn, my $Gbrother:sister;!

5531.name: Betina Bigglezink
desc: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.
objectives: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.
details: The eggs you brought were to be used in Scourge experiments to create a plagued dragonflight. These frozen black dragon eggs would have been invaluable in their studies, and would have assuredly quickened their timetable.
BNow, it is time we ended their research.

BTake the frozen eggs to Betina Bigglezink outside. She is well-learned in science and alchemy, and has produced a weapon we can use against the Scourge. With your help, we will deal them a heavy blow.
completion: There they are! And in such a nice container. The perfect size!
BWe'll keep these eggs in a safe place so we can study them later, but right now we need that thing you brought them in.

BI have created a device with a very specific use: to destroy the undead scholars of the Scholomance. They are studying dragons in their efforts to create a plagued dragonflight, and we must halt their progress.
BI call the device Dawn's Gambit, because... I'm not sure if it works!
BWill you find out for us?

5627.name: Stars of Elune
completion: You've proven yourself worthy of Elune's attention, $N. If you feel you're ready, I would very much like to teach you one of her spells unique to our people.

5651.name: In Favor of Darkness
desc: Speak to Dark Cleric Beryl in Tirisfal Glades.
objectives: Speak to Dark Cleric Beryl in Tirisfal Glades.
