details: There are many lessons that the Forsaken have learned through experience--things that some races can only begin to fathom. And although our path lies in darkness, you will find that a great many things rely on both the light and the dark. Your lessons shall teach you to use both... and with discretion. But heed my words: never forget we were forged in corruption and left to rot like so much carrion. The Darkness is our home.
BSeek out Dark Cleric Beryl in Brill when you're ready to learn more.
completion: Finally, you've arrived. Your faith alone will not allow you to pass the trials before you, young one. A sense of urgency and some ambition will help too.

5675.name: Elune's Grace
desc: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
details: Time's a wastin', $glad:lass;. It's time for you to return home to Darnassus. Priestess Alathea's sent word here that you're to return there for training. Seems they feel you're ready to be tested much like those who serve the Light. You should head out whenever you can. Alathea's message said that she'd be waitin' for you in the Temple of the Moon. Good luck.
completion: Elune bless you for returning so quickly to us. This is an important time in your training, and a time that all of our order take very seriously. When you've rested from your journey here, please, let me know. We can then discuss the continuation of your training and where your path will lead you next.

5723.name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
desc: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
details: Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.
BShe asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
completion: I am glad to see you took Magatha's task seriously. Thank you, $N. I'm sure the troggs will have a harder time coming to the surface with their numbers so greatly reduced.
BPerhaps in the future we can take time to figure out where such creatures came from, and what they really want.

5843.name: Welcome!
desc: Bring the Valley of Trials Gift Voucher to Magga.
objectives: Bring the Valley of Trials Gift Voucher to Magga.
details: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!

BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Magga in the Valley of Trials. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
completion: You are indeed a special hero, $N. We welcome you to the world of Azeroth, and offer you one of these unique gifts!

5891.name: Salve via Disenchanting
completion: Here are some Cenarion plant salves - I only need one lesser nether essence for this, $n. Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. If you need more salve, then find me here!

6083.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Surf Crawler. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar at Razor Hill.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Surf Crawler. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar at Razor Hill.
details: The advantage a pet affords you against your rivals is duly noted, $N. When you gain control over another creature, you are adding to your own strength. Your pet must become an extension of yourself.

BThe next task requires you to turn from the land; you will find the next creature in the waters off the coast. Across from Sen'jin Village, near the Echo Isles. look for a spirited crab called the surf crawler. Use the taming rod to tame it, then practice your skills.
completion: You are a swift learner, $N. You have done well.

6323.name: Ride to the Undercity
desc: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.
objectives: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.
details: One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee. Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.
BYou will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity. That is the same quarter where my bat will land.
completion: An order from the Sepulcher? Very well. It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.

6395.name: Marla's Last Wish
desc: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.
objectives: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.
details: My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks.
BMarla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband. So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel.
BSamuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell. Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.
completion: You have done a good deed today, $N. Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place.

6563.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
desc: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
objectives: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
details: Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.
BWill you help me, $N? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
completion: Well done, $N. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguing...
BI can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.

6611.name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
desc: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.
objectives: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.
details: How you expect Zamja teach you anything? You got all of Zamja's cooking mojo and still you crave more!
BZamja can't help. Fat $r needs to go to Gadgetzan. You find a little goblin named Dirge there - he help you, fatty.
BWhen you become big cook on the block, you come back and teach Zamja, ok? Now go!
completion: <Dirge spits out some leather sandal bits.>
BPfftooey...
B<Dirge hacks loudly.>
BWhat? I'll have you know that leather is surprisingly high in protein and low in carbohydrates.

7043.name: You're a Mean One...
desc: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.$B
details: A c-c-creature called "The Abominable Greench" is the one w-w-who stole our shipment of t-t-treats, $N. Be c-c-careful though! He is t-t-the one who turned me into this s-s-snowy mess!

BYou're g-g-gonna need some help in f-f-facing him. I've seen him w-w-wander all around where the y-y-yeti are; he's s-s-surely here s-s-somewhere! F-f-find the treats $N, take them b-b-back to Smokywood Pastures in Ironforge, and t-t-tell them I n-n-need to be unfrozen!
completion: You found it! You've saved Smokywood Pasture's Feast of Winter Veil!

BPoor Sacks... we'll be sure to send a team out there and figure out a way to unfreeze him. Hopefully, he'll be back in time for the day of the Feast; he'll need to make up missed time working though. Still, this wouldn't even be possible if it weren't for you!

7067.name: The Pariah's Instructions
desc: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.
objectives: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.
details: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.
BThe task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.
BIf you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.
completion: This is it, $R! This is it! Now I can begin the great task of uniting the tribes. Thank you.
BTake this for your efforts, please. I hope when next we meet, it will be on much different terms.

7163.name: Rise and Be Recognized
details: <Warmaster Laggrond salutes you.>
BIt is your time, $N. You have done much for the Frostwolf Clan and in doing so, earned a place as not only a soldier of Frostwolf but also as a friend.
BWell done! Present your initiate's insignia.$B
completion: This new insignia reflects your rank amongst the Frostwolf. Keep it on you at all times.$b$bAnd $c... Die with honor!

7499.name: Codex of Defense
desc: Return the book to its rightful owners.
objectives: Return the book to its rightful owners.
details: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
completion: Excellent work, $R. Should you find any more tomes, do not hesitate to return them to us.
BAs time passes, we tend to change around and even add new rewards for the return of missing tomes.

7643.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
desc: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food.

Travel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.
objectives: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food.

BTravel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.
details: Your barding needs a special form of blessing, one from an appropriate spirit. In Dire Maul is such a spirit, the Ancient Equine Spirit. It is currently held by a corrupt treant, Tendris Warpwood. Pass judgment upon this foul beast, $N.

BKnow this - freedom alone is not enough. You must soothe the spirit before receiving its blessing. For that, special horse feed is needed. Travel to Southshore first and speak with Merideth Carlson on this... and prepare for more sacrifice.
completion: The Ancient Equine Spirit accepts the offering of the Manna-Enriched Horse Feed, nuzzling the container as it helps itself to the special oats and grains. After it has eaten a little, it looks at the barding you possess and positions itself as though it wants you to place it upon its back...

7667.name: Material Assistance
desc: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.
objectives: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.
details: $N, there is a pressing matter I hope you can help with... both materially and spiritually. Allow me to explain.

BWithin the depths of the Scholomance in Lordaeron is a chamber called the Great Ossuary. I need to complete a device that would pierce the shadows of this horrid room. To finish what I have started, I need two diamonds: an Azerothian and a Pristine Black. These are not trivial items, I know - I just don't have the resources myself.
BCould you provide me with one of each?
completion: Your generosity is unrivaled, $N. I thank you for your kindness.

BI will be able to finish my divination scryer now, and I should be able to fashion more without further need of diamonds... perhaps you would be interested in helping me in its use? It is for a most important task, I assure you... one that left unchecked could spell unmitigated disaster for the spirit realm!

7787.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
desc: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.
objectives: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.
details: You have defeated the Wind Seeker. Take the dormant blade and force the lying wretch, Demitrian, to use the materials you provided for his betrayal to wake Thunderfury.
completion: Please do not harm me! Take it! Take the blade! Leave Demitrian to reshape his pathetic life!

7811.name: A Donation of Runecloth
completion: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.

BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!

7835.name: A Donation of Mageweave
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7907.name: Darkmoon Beast Deck
desc: Return the Beast Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

8051.name: The Eye of Zuldazar
completion: Continue in your battle against the Soulflayer and his minions, $n. He must never be permitted to leave the confines of Zul'Gurub.

8075.name: Paragons of Power: The Augur's Hauberk
desc: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Tabard. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Tabard. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
BMaywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: The augurs of the Zandalar all wear a distinctive chest piece called a hauberk. It's fitted with the finest of silks and cloths, interwoven with strong chain. It's a symbol of not only their divinity, but also of their authority, mon. It's never wise to cross one whose life is devoted to speakin' with the spirits...
BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do it and I'll give ya one of the finest hauberks our augurs would ever hope to wear!
completion: I know what ya had to go through to bring me the Paragons of Power, $N. It wasn't easy, mon - defeatin' the evil that seeps out of Zul'Gurub like a foul ooze - but now that it is all said and done, I can easily say that you'll be revered amongst the Zandalar for ages to come!
BHere - take the augur's hauberk and wear it with pride!

8123.name: Cut Arathor Supply Lines
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
objectives: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
details: The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.

BYou can help us, $N. Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.
completion: NULL

8147.name: The Maelstrom's Tendril
completion: Let them seek atonement at the end of your munitions.

8171.name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
desc: Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
objectives: Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
details: As you no doubt have heard, the League of Arathor is sending large numbers of troops into Arathi Basin. Eager for food and supplies, these Alliance fools are intent to take and control the rich resources there. We must show them that Arathi will never again be a home for humans!
BGo to Arathi Basin and assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the stables. Pull down the enemies' banners, declaring those territories for the Horde.
BGo, $N. Report back to me when this task is complete.
completion: NULL

8267.name: Ribbons of Sacrifice
desc: Bring the Ribbons of Sacrifice to Captain Shatterskull so that the Outriders may reward you for acting on our behalf.

8291.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
desc: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
details: Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young $c. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.
BEnter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces!
BDo this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, $N, and I shall reward you.
completion: NULL

8315.name: The Calling
desc: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism from the Qiraji Emissary.

You have been instructed to take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold, and draw them in the sand. Should the Qiraji Emissary appear, slay it and recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism. Return to Geologist Larksbane if you succeed.
Assemble an army for this task, $N!
objectives: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism from the Qiraji Emissary.

BYou have been instructed to take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold, and draw them in the sand. Should the Qiraji Emissary appear, slay it and recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism. Return to Geologist Larksbane if you succeed.
BAssemble an army for this task, $N!
details: The glyphs illustrate an emissary of the Qiraji meeting with three silithid at the bones of a large dragon. Above the glyphs is what I can only assume to be a code of some sort. This code might very well be the key to summoning the emissary.

BI will create a copy of the glyph code that you must use in the sand at the Bones of Grakkarond. If I am right, the Overlords will come thinking that new data is ready for transmission. Strike them down and confront the emissary. He holds the key to the crystals...
completion: I hold 20,000 years of history in my hands, $N!

8387.name: Invaders of Alterac Valley
desc: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8411.name: Mastering the Elements
desc: Bring the elements earth, air, fire and water to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
objectives: Bring the elements earth, air, fire and water to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
details: Welcome, $c. You bring me the elements and then we do the talkin'.
BThe fire, the air, the water, and the earth I be needin' before I trust ya, mon. I gots to know you be knowledgeable.
completion: These be the elements I need. Now we talk.

8435.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8507.name: Field Duty
desc: Report for duty at the Ironforge Brigade post near Hive'Zora. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers and obtain Signed Field Duty Papers from Captain Blackanvil and return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Note: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the Ironforge Brigade will flag you for PvP.

8555.name: The Charge of the Dragonflights
completion: Eranikus, Vaelastrasz, and Azuregos... No doubt you know of these dragons, mortal. It is no coincidence, then, that they have played such influential roles as watchers of our world.

BUnfortunately (and my own naivety is partially to blame) whether by agents of the Old Gods or betrayal by those that would call them friend, each guardian has fallen to tragedy. The extent of which has fueled my own distrust towards your kind.
BSeek them out... And $R, prepare yourself for the worst.

8579.name: Mortal Champions
completion: I see that you're no ordinary mortal, $n. Your chances against the Old God, however infinitely small, are greater than ours at this point. After all, while he expects dragons at his doorstep, he is not prepared for someone like you.$b$bJust as Anachronos and Staghelm defeated the Qiraji a thousand years ago through the alliance of mortal and dragon races, we too shall form a pact. Gain the trust of the Bronze Dragonflight and you'll gain our trust. Only then we shall make a true champion out of you.

8603.name: Vestments of the Oracle
desc: Bring the the Husk of the Old God, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8627.name: Avenger's Breastplate
desc: Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8651.name: Ironband the Elder
completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

8675.name: Skychaser the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8699.name: Band of Vaulted Secrets
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Azure Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Azure Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.
BThe gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.
BBring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $c.
completion: I will swap the gem on the ring for you. You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.

8723.name: Nightwind the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8747.name: The Path of the Protector
completion: Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted.$b$bThe signet ring of the protector will offer superior protection against the forces of evil.$b$bBe warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.

8771.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Sandstalkers
desc: Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Sandstalkers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

8795.name: The Alliance Needs Your Help!
desc: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
objectives: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
details: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Alliance needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $N!
BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Field Marshal Snowfall. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
completion: NULL

8867.name: Lunar Fireworks
desc: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.
objectives: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.
details: Every year the druids of Moonglade hold a celebration of our city's great triumph over an ancient evil.
BWe celebrate the wisdom of our elders, share in magnificent feasts and of course... shoot fireworks!
BFor a small donation you can purchase colorful rockets from our vendor. Try using some of the launchers around here, $N.
completion: Well done, $N.
BNow that you're in the spirit of things, why don't you take this invitation to the festival in Moonglade.
BIt's quite an enjoyable celebration, if you have the time to spare. We share food, drink, stories and of course... more fireworks!
BOpen the invitation while standing inside the circle of greater moonlight and you'll be transported to Moonglade.

8915.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Magister's Bindings to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Magister's Bindings to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.$B
details: Hail, $c! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.
BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.
BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
completion: Ah, yes. Mux will be quite happy with this.
BThose bindings were part of a larger armor set. If you're interested in providing me with further assistance, I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.

8939.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Magister's Belt and a set of Magister's Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring a Magister's Belt and a set of Magister's Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
details: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $N. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.
BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
completion: Our agreement remains in place. Just remember, this is but a taste of what awaits you. Free me of this cursed fate and I will reward you with items of truly great power.

8963.name: Components of Importance
desc: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
objectives: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
details: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

BIsalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
completion: A job well done, $N. I will imbue the essence of the relic into the brazier.

BNow all that is left is to go to the Shrine of Eldretharr in the east wing of Dire Maul, and use the brazier to summon forth the spirit of my former cohort, Isalien. Her spirit has been corrupted by her possession of the piece of Valthalak's amulet, and the portion of his soul within it.

8987.name: More Components of Importance
desc: Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
objectives: Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
details: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to summon the remains of my deceased, former comrades.

BThe siblings, Jarien and Sothos, were believers in the way of the Scarlet Crusade. They aspired to knighthood within that vile organization. Go to Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands and retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry from the praetorians there.$B
completion: A job well done, $N. I will imbue the essence of the sword into the brazier.

BNow all that is left is to get into The Crimson Throne inside The Scarlet Bastion at Stratholme, and use the brazier to summon forth the remains of my former cohorts, Jarien and Sothos. Their souls have been twisted further by their possession of Valthalak's amulet piece and his spirit within.
BOh, by the way, I had some leftover bloodkelp from your trip to Alcaz Isle, so I made it into some potions for you. Take your pick!

9011.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Mokvar your Coif of Elements and Vest of Elements.
objectives: Give Mokvar your Coif of Elements and Vest of Elements.
details: A truly amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.
BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
completion: I will truly miss you, $N. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.
BEnjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!

9059.name: Cryptstalker Handguards
desc: Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Cryptstalker Handguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Handguards, 8 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.

9083.name: Bonescythe Waistguard
desc: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Bonescythe Waistguard if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Waistguard, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 5 Cured Rugged Hides, 1 Nexus Crystal and 15 gold pieces.

9107.name: Plagueheart Sandals
desc: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Sandals if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sandals, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

9131.name: Binding the Dreadnaught
desc: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Dark Iron Scraps.
objectives: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Dark Iron Scraps.
details: Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, $c? No, of course you haven't. You're still a $g boy:girl; - a tyke. Let me tell you, it is glorious.
BYou're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.
BI need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. Bring me scraps and get paid.
completion: This will do, for now. If you get more, you know where to find me.

9179.name: Craftsman's Writ - Imperial Plate Chest
desc: Deliver 3 Imperial Plate Chests and the Craftsman's Writ - Imperial Plate Chest - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9203.name: Craftsman's Writ - Flask of Petrification
desc: Deliver 1 Flask of Petrification and the Craftsman's Writ - Flask of Petrification - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9227.name: Superior Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
desc: For 6 Insignias of the Dawn and 6 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

9251.name: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff
desc: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants the Staff Head of Atiesh and the Base of Atiesh.
objectives: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants the Staff Head of Atiesh and the Base of Atiesh.
details: You question why you are still alive. After all, you have in your possession an item of great evil. The answer is not clear, $N. I only do as I must.
BKel'Thuzad sits atop his throne in Naxxramas, plotting... He seeks that which you hold and holds that which you seek.
BAs for the base of the staff; the dwarf, Brann Bronzebeard, held it when he entered Ahn'Qiraj. He has left Ahn'Qiraj but the base of Atiesh remains.
BShould you succeed in recovering the pieces, return them to me.
completion: There is a being within... a being not of this world.

9299.name: Note from the Front
desc: Take the Careworn Note to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Careworn Note to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
completion: How tragic. These words, clearly meant for someone the soldier loved, never made it to their destination. The events detailed happened years ago; I'm not sure if the intended recipient still lives.
BThere is hope yet, however. With the names and information he gives, I might be able to locate the family! It will take some research, but the librarian in Stormwind owes me a favor...
BThank you for bringing this to me. With your help, we may be able to grant someone peace of mind at least.

9323.name: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms
desc: Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
objectives: Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
details: Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, $c. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.

BYou'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.
B Return once your journey is done.
completion: Ah, here you are. A little wearier, a bit dustier, but enlightened! The heat touches us all during this season and unites us; your very being glows with the power of the fires you touched. Ah, but these days enlightenment is taken as a rather poor reward for being sent on a task, I suppose. Take these, then, and enjoy the celebration.

9419.name: Scouring the Desert
desc: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
objectives: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
details: We recently found out that the Horde has been scavenging the Silithus desert for resources, but paid them little mind. We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.
BHowever, it was discovered the importance of the resources, and now we are scrambling to catch up.
BIf I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.
completion: Thank the Light you were successful.
BNow if we could only have started this sooner, our need would not be so desperate. We must keep the bounty of the desert from falling into the hands of the Horde.

objectives: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
details: Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.
Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.

objectives: Speak to Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
*Arcane Mote (provided)
details: The council will not be happy to learn of our subterfuge, but they cannot deny results. The city is calming down, and we are free to lower our wards.
I think it's only fair you deliver the good word. Take this mote to Archmage Celindra within the Violet Citadel.

objectives: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.
* Simple Note (Zephras Isle) (provided)
details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.
He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.

objectives: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.
*Suspicious Industrial Supplies (8)
details: Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.
I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of , but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?
Please travel to Moonbrook, , and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!

objectives: Use the detonator.
* Detonator used
details: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.

objectives: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
details: A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.
Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.

objectives: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in .
details: You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.
If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
